title: Singular supports, characteristic cycles, and microlocalization of constructible sheaves
summary: For a constructible sheaf $\mathcal{F}$ on a smooth scheme $X$ over a perfect field, the singular support $SS(\mathcal{F})$ and the characteristic cycle $CC(\mathcal{F})$ are defined on the cotangent bundle. In analogy with the construction of Kashiwara--Schapira via microlocalization in the transcendental setting, we construct the microlocal versions ${ SS}_μ(\mathcal{F})$ and $CC_μ(\mathcal{F})$ of $SS(\mathcal{F})$ and $CC(\mathcal{F})$ respectively, and prove \[ SS_μ(\mathcal{F})= SS(\mathcal{F}),\qquad CC_μ(\mathcal{F})= {\rm cl}CC(\mathcal{F}), \] where $\operatorname{cl}$ is the cycle…
